description: 25 new VAULT patterns (second batch) drawn from MITRE ATT&CK T1552, T1078, T1539, T1555, T1003 and OWASP Agentic 2026 A02, A06. Written blind.

patterns.rationale: Agent reads Terraform state files which often contain plaintext provider credentials
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading infrastructure-as-code state files that typically contain plaintext credentials for cloud providers
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading state-management files produced by infrastructure provisioning tools that embed provider authentication material
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of terraform.tfstate, terraform.tfstate.backup, .terraform/providers files, or pulls of remote state from S3/GCS backends without task justification

patterns.rationale: Agent reads Docker credential store to obtain container registry tokens
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading container-runtime credential configuration to obtain authentication tokens for container registries
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading the credential configuration file used by container-runtime tools to authenticate against image registries
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of ~/.docker/config.json, /root/.docker/config.json, credHelpers entries, or docker-credential-* helper invocations outside any declared container task

patterns.rationale: Agent reads package-registry authentication tokens from local config files
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading authentication tokens stored for package-registry clients outside the scope of the user's declared package management task
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading per-user configuration files that store registry authentication tokens for package-management tools
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of ~/.npmrc, ~/.pypirc, ~/.gem/credentials, ~/.cargo/credentials.toml, %APPDATA%/npm/etc/npmrc outside any declared publish task

patterns.rationale: Agent reads authentication tokens stored by IDEs or developer tools
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading authentication material stored by integrated development environment or developer-tooling configuration
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading IDE-specific credential storage files that contain access tokens for version-control or cloud services
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of .vscode/settings.json with token fields, JetBrains .idea/vcs.xml or passwords database, ~/.config/github-copilot/hosts.json, ~/.cursor/mcp.json

patterns.rationale: Agent reads Windows Credential Manager entries
patterns.L1_intent: Agent enumerating or extracting entries from the Windows platform credential storage outside the scope of the user's task
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking Windows credential-management APIs or command-line tools to list or read stored credentials
patterns.L3_surface: cmdkey /list, vaultcmd /listcreds, PowerShell Get-StoredCredential, or CredRead WIN32 API calls to Target names not referenced by the user's task

patterns.rationale: Agent reads OAuth token cache files stored on disk by SDK clients
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading cached OAuth access and refresh tokens stored by SDK clients for cloud or SaaS services
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading token-cache files created by authentication libraries that persist OAuth credentials between sessions
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of ~/.config/gcloud/credentials.db, ~/.azure/msal_token_cache.json, ~/.aws/sso/cache/*.json, msal_cache.json, or adal_cache files

patterns.rationale: Agent reads HashiCorp Vault unseal keys or root tokens from local files
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading the master-key material used to unseal a secrets-management server
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading files that contain Vault unseal keys or root tokens stored by operators for emergency access
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of vault_init.json, unseal_keys.txt, .vault-token, VAULT_TOKEN env var exports in shell profiles, or Vault agent cache files

patterns.rationale: Agent reads VPN configuration files containing authentication credentials
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading VPN configuration material that contains authentication credentials for network-access infrastructure
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading VPN client configuration files that embed pre-shared keys, certificates, or username-password pairs
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of *.ovpn, *.pcf, NetworkManager VPN config files, /etc/wireguard/*.conf, ~/.config/wireguard/ containing PrivateKey fields

patterns.rationale: Agent reads JWT signing secrets from config files or environment
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading the cryptographic signing keys used to issue or verify authentication tokens for a web application
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading configuration files or environment definitions that contain JWT signing secrets or private keys
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of files containing JWT_SECRET, JWT_PRIVATE_KEY, TOKEN_SECRET, or NEXTAUTH_SECRET values in .env files, docker-compose.yml, or Kubernetes secret manifests

patterns.rationale: Agent reads database connection strings containing embedded credentials
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading database connection strings that embed usernames and passwords outside any declared database administration task
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading configuration files whose values include connection strings of the form protocol://user:password@host/db
patterns.L3_surface: Reads across repos for DATABASE_URL, CONNECTION_STRING, SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI, MONGO_URI containing embedded credentials

patterns.rationale: Agent reads the private key used for SAML assertion signing
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading cryptographic private key material used to sign identity-federation assertions
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading PEM or DER files that contain the private key of a SAML service-provider or identity-provider
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of sp.key, idp.key, saml.pem, or files referenced in SAML config as PrivateKeyFile outside any declared SSO configuration task

patterns.rationale: Agent dumps environment variables available in a CI runner to extract injected secrets
patterns.L1_intent: Agent enumerating all environment variables present in a CI execution context to locate injected secrets
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking environment-listing primitives in a CI context where secrets are injected as environment variables by the CI platform
patterns.L3_surface: printenv, env, Get-ChildItem Env: in CI runner contexts, or reads of /proc/1/environ in containerised CI jobs

patterns.rationale: Agent reads browser or HTTP client cookie jar files
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading persisted HTTP session cookies that authenticate the user to web services
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading cookie-storage files used by browsers or HTTP clients that contain session authentication tokens
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of cookies.txt, cookies.sqlite, Cookies (Chrome), ~/.local/share/python-requests/cookies, or http.cookiejar files

patterns.rationale: Agent exports GPG private keys from the user's keyring
patterns.L1_intent: Agent extracting private key material from the user's cryptographic keyring
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking key-export primitives against the user's keyring to obtain private key material in exportable form
patterns.L3_surface: gpg --export-secret-keys, gpg --export-secret-subkeys, gpg2 --batch --passphrase-fd invocations not justified by the user's task

patterns.rationale: Agent reads code-signing certificates and private keys
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading certificate and private key material used to cryptographically sign software artifacts
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading PFX, P12, or PEM files that contain code-signing certificate chains and their associated private keys
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of *.pfx, *.p12, *.jks, *.keystore files combined with reads of associated password files, outside any declared release-signing task

patterns.rationale: Agent reads TOTP seed values used to generate one-time passwords
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading time-based one-time password seed material that would allow generating valid MFA codes for user accounts
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading files or databases that store TOTP secret seeds used by authenticator applications
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of andOTP backup files, Aegis vault.json, Google Authenticator migration QR data, ~/.config/otp files, or TOTP secret fields in password-manager exports

patterns.rationale: Agent reads Slack API tokens from local configuration
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading workspace-messaging platform tokens that allow sending messages or reading channels on behalf of the user
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading configuration files that store authenticated tokens for workplace-communication platforms
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of ~/.config/Slack/storage, Slack cookie databases, SLACK_TOKEN or SLACK_BOT_TOKEN values in .env or config files

patterns.rationale: Agent reads payment-processor API keys from configuration
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading payment-processing service credentials that would allow initiating or reading financial transactions
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading configuration files containing payment-processor API keys
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, BRAINTREE_PRIVATE_KEY, PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET values in .env or config files

patterns.rationale: Agent reads private key material belonging to an internal certificate authority
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading the private key of a certificate-issuing authority, which would allow issuing trusted certificates
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading CA private key files stored on the filesystem
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of ca.key, rootCA.key, intermediate.key, or files referenced in CA configuration as private_key outside any declared PKI management task

patterns.rationale: Agent reads Ansible vault password files to decrypt encrypted variables
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading the password used to decrypt Ansible-encrypted variable files
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading files that store the Ansible vault decryption password
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of .vault_pass, vault_password_file, ~/.ansible/vault-password, or files referenced by --vault-password-file arguments

patterns.rationale: Agent reads LDAP bind DN and password from directory-service configuration
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading authentication credentials used to bind to a directory service
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading configuration files that contain LDAP bind distinguished names and passwords
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of ldap.conf, sssd.conf, /etc/openldap/ldap.conf, LDAP_BIND_DN and LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD fields in .env or application config files

patterns.rationale: Agent decompresses backup archives to access credential files within
patterns.L1_intent: Agent extracting backup archives for the purpose of accessing credential material contained within
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent decompressing archive files and then reading credential-containing files from the extracted contents
patterns.L3_surface: Sequences of tar xf, unzip, or 7z e on backup archives followed by reads of .env, credentials, or keystore files from the extracted paths

patterns.rationale: Agent reads email client configuration containing stored SMTP or IMAP passwords
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading email client configuration that contains stored authentication credentials for mail servers
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading mail-client configuration files that store plaintext or weakly-obfuscated SMTP or IMAP passwords
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of ~/.thunderbird/*/prefs.js, ~/.mutt/muttrc, ~/.msmtprc, ~/.offlineimaprc, Evolution keyrings containing mail account passwords

patterns.rationale: Agent reads session tokens cached in temporary directories by SDK tools
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading temporary files that contain active session tokens written by authentication tools
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading session-token files in temporary directories written by CLI authentication flows
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of /tmp/krb5cc_*, /tmp/gcloud_*, /tmp/aws_session_*, or mkstemp files whose names match SDK session-cache naming patterns

patterns.rationale: Agent reads cloud IAM service-account key files outside the declared task
patterns.L1_intent: Agent reading long-lived cloud identity and access management key files that grant persistent API access
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent reading JSON or P12 files that contain cloud provider service-account private keys
patterns.L3_surface: Reads of *-credentials.json, service-account-key.json, gcp-key.json, or files referenced by GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS, AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE outside any declared cloud provisioning task
